news.title: More Michigan students need AP classes, other rigorous coursework, report says
news.summary_en: A new study says too many students aren’t prepared for postsecondary education, especially students who are Black, Latino, low-income, disabled and English learners. Rural students are also missing out.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski

news.title: Rick Snyder: Provide Michigan education that’s ‘more than academics’
news.summary_en: With just over half of Michigan high school graduates going off to college, leaders say more needs to be done to give them interesting and useful learning experiences in K-12 schools.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: Work program helps Michigan students with disabilities. Will funding run dry?
news.summary_en: At Project SEARCH, students learn what jobs they do and don’t like. They also get support from peers, instructors and employers. Independence and employment are the goals.
news.author: Isabel Lohman
